57360.subject: Technical Drawing
57360.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm using only a compass and a straightedge. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
57360.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center and radius greater than half of AB, draw arcs above and below AB.
3. With B as center and the same radius, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Draw a straight line through points C and D. This line is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label the midpoint of AB as M, where the bisector intersects AB.

57361.subject: Technical Drawing
57361.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with a side length of 30 mm using only a compass and a straightedge. Show all construction lines and label the vertices A, B, C, D, E, and F.
57361.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the hexagon.
5. Ensure all sides are equal and all construction lines are visible.

57362.subject: Technical Drawing
57362.question_text: Construct a tangent to a given circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm away from the center O of the circle. Show all construction lines and label the point of tangency T.
57362.explanation:
1. Draw the given circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Draw line OP.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of OP to find its midpoint M.
5. With M as center and radius OM, draw a semicircle intersecting the given circle at T.
6. Draw line PT, which is the required tangent.
7. Label the point of tangency T.

57363.subject: Technical Drawing
57363.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given object in first-angle orthographic projection. The object is a rectangular block 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm with a semicircular slot of radius 10 mm cut from the top face along the 40 mm edge. Show all hidden details.
57363.explanation:
1. Draw the front view: 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height) with a semicircular slot of radius 10 mm at the top.
2. Draw the top view: 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth) showing the semicircular slot as a rectangle with semicircles at the ends.
3. Draw the right-side view: 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height) showing the semicircular slot as a hidden detail.
4. Ensure all hidden lines are dashed and visible lines are continuous.

57364.subject: Technical Drawing
57364.question_text: Given the front and top views of an object in first-angle orthographic projection, draw the missing right-side view. The front view shows a rectangle 50 mm × 30 mm with a circular hole of diameter 20 mm centered on the vertical axis. The top view shows a rectangle 50 mm × 40 mm with the same circular hole centered on the horizontal axis.
57364.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the depth of the object (40 mm).
2. Draw the right-side view: 40 mm (depth) × 30 mm (height) with the circular hole appearing as a hidden detail (dashed circle) centered vertically.
3. Ensure the hole is correctly projected as a hidden line in the side view.

57365.subject: Technical Drawing
57365.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object, which is a hollow cylinder of outer diameter 50 mm, inner diameter 30 mm, and height 40 mm, cut by a vertical plane passing through its axis. Show the section hatching and label all dimensions.
57365.explanation:
1. Draw the outer circle of diameter 50 mm and the inner circle of diameter 30 mm.
2. Draw vertical lines to represent the height of 40 mm.
3. Apply section hatching (45° lines) to the cut surfaces of the cylinder.
4. Label the outer diameter (50 mm), inner diameter (30 mm), and height (40 mm).

57366.subject: Technical Drawing
57366.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block 60 mm × 40 mm × 30 mm with a circular hole of diameter 20 mm drilled through the center of the top face. Show all hidden details and label the dimensions.
57366.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Construct the block using the given dimensions: 60 mm (length), 40 mm (width), and 30 mm (height).
3. Draw the circular hole as an ellipse on the top face, centered and with a major axis of 20 mm.
4. Show hidden lines for the hole using dashed lines.
5. Label all dimensions clearly.

57367.subject: Technical Drawing
57367.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with a base diameter of 50 mm and a slant height of 60 mm. Show all construction lines and label the dimensions.
57367.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi d = \pi \times 50$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius 60 mm (slant height) and arc length equal to the circumference of the base.
3. The angle of the sector is calculated as $\theta = (C / (2 \pi r)) \times 360° = (50 / 60) \times 360° = 300°$.
4. Draw the sector with the calculated angle and label the dimensions.

57368.subject: Technical Drawing
57368.question_text: Draw the line of intersection between a vertical cylinder of diameter 40 mm and a horizontal cylinder of diameter 30 mm, where the axes intersect at right angles. Show all construction lines and the curve of intersection.
57368.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of both cylinders.
2. Divide the circumference of the vertical cylinder into equal parts (e.g., 12 parts) and project these points to the top view.
3. Draw horizontal lines from the top view to intersect the horizontal cylinder in the front view.
4. Plot the points of intersection and draw a smooth curve through them.
5. Show all construction lines and the final curve of intersection.

57369.subject: Technical Drawing
57369.question_text: Dimension the following orthographic views of a simple bracket: front view (50 mm × 30 mm with a 10 mm diameter hole centered 15 mm from the top edge) and top view (50 mm × 20 mm with the same hole centered). Apply standard dimensioning conventions.
57369.explanation:
1. In the front view, dimension the overall height (30 mm) and width (50 mm).
2. Dimension the hole diameter (10 mm) and its vertical position (15 mm from the top edge).
3. In the top view, dimension the overall width (50 mm) and depth (20 mm).
4. Dimension the hole diameter (10 mm) and its horizontal position (centered).
5. Ensure all dimensions are placed outside the views and use standard dimensioning symbols.
